verses.pali: อิทัมปิ พุทเธ ระตะนัง ปะณีตัง.
verses.english: This too is an excellent jewel in the Buddha.

verses.pali: เอเตนะ สัจเจนะ สุวัตถิ โหตุ.
verses.english: By this truth, may there be well-being.

verses.pali: ขะยัง วิราคัง อะมะตัง ปะณีตัง
verses.english: The ending, the fading away, the deathless, the excellent —

verses.pali: ยะทัชฌะคา สัก๎ยะมุนี สะมาหิโต
verses.english: which the concentrated Sage of the Sakyans attained;

verses.pali: นะ เตนะ ธัมเมนะ สะมัตถิ กิญจิ
verses.english: there is nothing equal to that Dhamma.

verses.pali: อิทัมปิ ธัมเม ระตะนัง ปะณีตัง
verses.english: This too is an excellent jewel in the Dhamma.

verses.pali: เอเตนะ สัจเจนะ สุวัตถิ โหตุ.
verses.english: By this truth, may there be well-being.

verses.pali: ยัมพุทธะเสฏโฐ ปะริวัณณะยี สุจิง
verses.english: That purity which the supreme Buddha praised,

verses.pali: สะมาธิมานันตะริกัญญะมาหุ
verses.english: the concentration they call immediate —

verses.pali: สะมาธินา เตนะ นะโม นะ วิชชะติ
verses.english: there is nothing to compare with that concentration.

verses.pali: อิทัมปิ ธัมเม ระตะนัง ปะณีตัง.
verses.english: This too is an excellent jewel in the Dhamma.

verses.pali: เอเตนะ สัจเจนะ สุวัตถิ โหตุ.
verses.english: By this truth, may there be well-being.

verses.pali: เย ปุคคะลา อัฏฐะ สะตัง ปะสัตถา
verses.english: Those eight persons, praised by the good,

verses.pali: จัตตาริ เอตานิ ยุคานิ โหนติ
verses.english: who make these four pairs,

verses.pali: เต ทักขิเณยยา สุคะตัสสะ สาวะกา
verses.english: the disciples of the Well-Gone One, worthy of offerings —

verses.pali: เอเตสุ ทินนานิ มะหัปผะลานิ
verses.english: what is given to them bears great fruit.

verses.pali: อิทัมปิ สังเฆ ระตะนัง ปะณีตัง
verses.english: This too is an excellent jewel in the Sangha.

verses.pali: เอเตนะ สัจเจนะ สุวัตถิ โหตุ.
verses.english: By this truth, may there be well-being.

verses.pali: เย สุปปะยุตตา มะนะสา ทัพเหนะ
verses.english: Those who, with firm mind, apply themselves well

verses.pali: นิกกามิโน โคตะมะสาสะนัมหิ
verses.english: and are free of desire in the teaching of Gotama,

verses.pali: เต ปัตติปัตตา อะมะตัง วิคัยหะ
verses.english: they have reached the goal, plunged into the deathless,

verses.pali: ลัทธา มุธา นิพพุติง ภุญชะมานา
verses.english: and enjoy the peace they gained for nothing.

verses.pali: อิทัมปิ สังเฆ ระตะนัง ปะณีตัง.
verses.english: This too is an excellent jewel in the Sangha.

verses.pali: เอเตนะ สัจเจนะ สุวัตถิ โหตุ.
verses.english: By this truth, may there be well-being.

verses.pali: ขีณัง ปุราณัง นะวัง นัตถิ สัมภะวัง
verses.english: The old is destroyed, no new arising is there,

verses.pali: วิรัตตะจิตตายะติเก ภะวัส๎มิง
verses.english: their minds detached from any future becoming.

vocabulary.pali: อะนันตะริกะสะมาธิ
vocabulary.meaning: the immediate concentration — the collectedness that yields its fruit without any interval, which the sutta says has no equal

vocabulary.pali: ทักขิเณยยา
vocabulary.meaning: worthy of offerings. The eight persons — four pairs — who make the Sangha a field of merit

vocabulary.pali: ลัทธา มุธา
vocabulary.meaning: having gained it for nothing, without price. Said of the peace the disciples enjoy

checks.issue: ‼‼ ทัพเหนะ IS PRINTED WITH พ WHERE THE CANON HAS ฬ — daḷhena — and THE SAME BOOK PRINTS IT WITH ฬ ELSEWHERE. The page-82 printing of this very chant has ทัฬ๎เหนะ at its verse 30, with ฬ and a yamakkan. Read at 4x on this sheet and checked against chanting.py. ⚠️ THIS IS THE MOST USEFUL INSTANCE OF THE ฬ/พ PATTERN SO FAR, because it settles the open question: the printer HAS the ฬ glyph and uses it, so the พ spellings on pages 131, 143, 163 and here are the printing failing rather than a house convention. Reproduced as printed, and romanised dabhena following the project's dominant พ→b rule — the same choice made for โอพาโร on page 163, and the same four-way inconsistency noted there still stands.

‼ นะโม IS PRINTED WHERE THE PAGE-82 PRINTING HAS สะโม, and the sense wants สะโม. The line means there is nothing EQUAL to that concentration — samo, equal — and นะโม is the word for homage, which does not fit. Read at 4x and again on a line-ends strip at 2.8x; the letter is plainly น. Reproduced as printed and NOT corrected either to the canon or to the other printing. This looks like a misprint in the book and is exactly the kind of thing this record exists to catch.

‼‼ THE ABRIDGEMENT SKIPS STANZAS HERE. After verse 35 this sheet goes straight to ขีณัง ปุราณัง นะวัง นัตถิ สัมภะวัง, where the page-82 printing continues with ยะถินทะขีโล ปะฐะวิง สิโต สิยา and several further stanzas before reaching it. So เจ็ดตำนานย่อ abridges this chant by dropping whole stanzas, not just a preamble as it did with the Mangala. Recorded because a missing stanza looks exactly like a page mis-read, and because it means the two printings can no longer be compared verse number against verse number from here on.

‼ THE FOUR อิทัมปิ … ปะณีตัง LINES ARE PUNCTUATED TWO WAYS ON ONE SHEET. Verses 17 and 28 end with NO mark; verses 22 and 34 end with a FULL STOP. Every line ending on the page was read from a dedicated strip crop at 2.8x rather than at page scale, which is the only reason this was seen. The page-82 printing has no stop on any of the four. Reproduced as printed.

SINGLE COLUMN, re-profiled for this sheet: the only white corridors are at x 395-611 and x 1424-1888, which are the margins, with no internal gutter. The chant was two-column-free on 167 as well, but the sheet above it was not, so this was checked rather than carried forward.

TWENTY-SIX LINES, COUNTED FROM AN INK PROFILE rather than by eye, because the page is an unbroken run of similar short lines where a miscount is easy and invisible afterwards. The stanza indents were measured too and fall at verses 14, 19, 24, 30 and 36.

THE PAGE ENDS ON A COMPLETE PADA with clear paper below, so NO […] is marked and page 169 opens a new line. A hand covers part of the left margin in the photograph but no text; it is why the automatic left-edge measurements on two lines read anomalously low.
